Plaza suite champagne cocktails.d: A sugar cube soaked in bitters and a splash of cognac, topped up with chilled brut, lemon twist.

Chinatown dumplings.d: Pork and chive, pan-fried until the bottoms go crisp, with black vinegar and chili oil for dipping.

Plaza Hotel prawn cocktail.d: Jumbos poached and iced over shredded iceberg, red sauce sharp with horseradish, lemon wedge.
Plaza Hotel prawn cocktail.note: On ice when you sit down.

Frank's Plaza steak dinner.d: Seared and rested, cracked pepper sauce finished with brandy and cream. Pommes frites.

New York cheesecake.d: Dense, with sour cream and lemon zest beaten through, baked slow in a water bath on a buttered crumb crust.
New York cheesecake.note: From the bakery up the block.
